label: Accessibility
description: How the offices and the site work for everyone.

settings.text:
Both offices have step-free entrances. Oakfield has a hearing loop at the front desk, and we print every form in large type on request.

This site is built to work with a keyboard and a screen reader. If anything gets in your way, call us on (262) 555-0148 or email hello@oakfielddental.example and we'll help.
